high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of several donuts arranged on a white surface. The donuts are frosted with white icing and topped with colorful cereal pieces in shades of orange, pink, and yellow. Some of the donuts have a circular sticker or decoration in the center, featuring a green background with an image of a person's face and the text "JINGLE BALL" along with a small Christmas tree graphic. The stickers also include logos for iHeartRadio and KA100.
